title: RetroBIOS campaign finding
description: One line of measurements/findings.jsonl: what a real-condition run showed about one field of one profile entry, the rule that settled it or the reason it waits for review, and the records that show it. Lines are appended, never rewritten: the latest line of a key is its state.

id.description: Date and the first 12 hex digits of the sha256 of the line without its id, in canonical JSON.

key.description: emulator/system/file/field: the lines of one key are the history of one claim.

status.description: applied: the rule table settled the field and the profile was changed. open: no rule settles it, it waits for review. flagged: a declared file the runs never opened. resolved: a later run found the profile in agreement.

evidence.description: Ids of the records in measurements/<emulator>.jsonl that show it.
